node: Precision substrates and components for 800G/1.6T AI optical transceivers
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI optical-interconnect substrate/component node. The strongest underfollowed lead is AXTI, because indium phosphide substrates are directly tied to high-speed optical lasers/transceivers and recent evidence points to a step-change in InP revenue, backlog, and capacity plans. POET is included as a speculative-shadow candidate because its optical interposer/engine approach could sit adjacent to the substrate/component bottleneck, but commercialization evidence is still weaker. Fabrinet is not a substrate producer but is a second-order precision optical manufacturing/packaging chokepoint for high-speed modules. Coherent is included only as a reference anchor because it is a much more visible optical-component/module leader whose disclosures validate 800G/1.6T demand and component complexity.
